benchmark_families.target: 100_percent supported-subset parity against pinned upstream REA and separately pinned decoder oracles; zero false accepts for CRC/size corruption, partial streams, metadata disagreement, source mutation or actual-output limit violations; bounded memory independent of member size; performance scored only after correctness gates pass.

boundaries.first_lane: metadata inventory plus per-occurrence Stored/Deflate streamed SHA-256; no extraction, password handling, decryption or execution
boundaries.verification_semantics: a member result requires EOF, observed-size agreement and decoder CRC success; declared compressed size is never reported as observed bytes
boundaries.whole_archive_coverage: one verified member does not upgrade archive traversal from partial to complete
boundaries.cross_parser_disagreement: preserve each parser's versioned result and dependency lineage; never majority-vote away disagreement
boundaries.source_race: a changed held descriptor or selected path suppresses any would-be content result
boundaries.resource_bound: read buffer 1..=1 MiB; decoder state measured separately; never claim constant memory without peak RSS evidence
boundaries.source_identity_platform_scope: Unix content verification uses device/inode/size/mode/mtime/ctime descriptor and path checks. Non-Unix content verification is explicitly Unsupported until handle-bound identity is independently qualified in #10452; metadata inventory remains best-effort.
boundaries.file_identity_claim: File identity is not content immutability, producer authenticity, or proof no malicious writer exists.
boundaries.deflate_oracle: zip 9.3.0 test-only with flate2/zlib-rs decodes the exact Deflate stream emitted by zipcore/miniz_oxide; this qualifies codec implementation diversity, not independent ZIP CRC lineage.
boundaries.crc_oracle: zipcore and zip use crc32fast 1.5.4 at the ZIP CRC layer; Symthaea's bitwise CRC known-answer test is separate but not equivalent to a fully independent end-to-end corruption oracle.
boundaries.crc_verification: A verified result requires both zipcore's decoder CRC/size EOF acceptance and Symthaea's independently implemented incremental bitwise CRC-32 matching the declared ZIP CRC. zip and zipcore still share crc32fast 1.5.4 and therefore do not count as independent ZIP CRC libraries.
boundaries.session_optimization: Current per-member decoder open preserves max_entry_size=min(caller_limit,member_declared_size). A reusable archive session may reduce repeated metadata parsing, but must retain equivalent per-member output bounds; a single global Archive ReadOptions cap is not assumed equivalent.
boundaries.zip_rs_duplicate_names: zip 9.3.0 ZipArchive metadata stores entries in a raw-name-keyed IndexMap. len/indexing is unique-name-oriented; has_duplicate_names reports raw count greater than unique map size. It is not a duplicate-occurrence oracle.
boundaries.zip64_prefixed_stub: The verifier opens a bounded virtual Read+Seek view over the same source, beginning exactly at the custom parser's admitted leading_bytes offset. The secondary decoder's heuristic offset correction is disabled; its central-directory offset is compared in ZIP-relative coordinates, and member local-header offsets are rebased to absolute carrier coordinates. The implementation and fixture are authored; exact-head tests must establish support.
boundaries.virtual_archive_slice: The decoder view is bounded to [leading_bytes, source_bytes), cannot read prefix bytes or seek past the selected file's end, and is backed by an independently opened descriptor plus a separate identity witness. It is not a copied/extracted archive.

library_candidates.zipcore: zipcore 0.10.2 pinned candidate for bounded streaming, CRC/size verification and by-index duplicate occurrence access; audit source and dependency graph before promotion
library_candidates.zip_rs: zip 9.3.0 test-only oracle with deflate-flate2-zlib-rs enabled. The test harness decodes the exact zipcore/miniz_oxide-generated Deflate stream through flate2/zlib-rs, then compares the output to the production zipcore verifier. Parser, Deflate codec and ZIP-level CRC lineage are separate dimensions; zip and zipcore still share crc32fast 1.5.4 for ZIP CRC.
library_candidates.upstream: pinned REA TypeScript ArtifactReader/ZipArtifactReader at upstream SHA 8250bf2320ea57aab4e664db4b4d44b8abd2004e remains the behavioral oracle
library_candidates.note: An oracle disagreement is retained with provenance and minimized fixture; it is not resolved by selecting the majority implementation.
library_candidates.rawzip: rawzip 0.5.2 evaluation candidate for low-level structure/wayfinder oracle only. It delegates bomb limits, overlapping extent checks, duplicate names and expected central-directory entry-count reconciliation to the consumer; these are required adapter controls.
library_candidates.independence: zipcore 0.10.2 and zip 9.3.0 share crc32fast 1.5.4 for ZIP-level CRC, so these parser results are not independent CRC-library oracles. Symthaea now computes a separate incremental bitwise CRC-32 over each decompressed output chunk and compares it against the declared CRC in addition to zipcore's decoder CRC/size result. zip 9.3.0 test-only with deflate-flate2-zlib-rs separately decodes the zipcore/miniz_oxide-generated Deflate stream.

claim_boundaries.receipt_integrity: A receipt is an auditable record of the verifier's claim and inputs. Its own digest or signature does not increase the strength of the underlying observation.
claim_boundaries.authenticity: Not established by SHA-256, CRC, parser agreement or receipt signature alone; requires separate producer/build attestation and trust-root evaluation.
claim_boundaries.completeness: A verified member does not establish that all archive content, APK Signing Block records or package semantics were inspected.
claim_boundaries.semantics: A byte digest does not establish installability, runtime behavior, maliciousness/benignness or MASVS control pass.
claim_boundaries.identity: A source file identity tuple is distinct from a whole-archive digest and distinct from an immutable content snapshot.
